attributes.converted: Debt census (gdlmem debt / brief raw_offset_debt) 53 -> 4 bare_sites (92.5% reduction; the 4 remaining are the +0x10 sub-offset literal inside the still-opaque Item.data union, see sites_left_raw). Added 3 new file-local view structs following the file's existing BossPlayerView/BossObjView pattern (never #include the canonical game/item.h, game/enemy.h, game/critter.h headers directly, since each would create a genuine cross-TU extern redeclaration conflict with this TU's own already-existing externs -- item.h's PlaceItem returns Item* vs this TU's void*, enemy.h's gEnemies is Enemy[25] vs this TU's u8[]): SpewObjView (Item fields touched by gSpewItems[i].obj: objgrp@4, worldPos[3]@0x34 = objgrp.worldmat[3][0..2], active@0xc4, data[0x14]@0xdc); EnemyTailView (Enemy tail fields touched by BossGenerateEnemy's index-computed `e`: pyr[3]@0x240, ang@0x24c, angbak@0x250, birth_pos[3]@0x2ec); BossCritterView (Critter fields touched via gBossObj: hdr@4, mtx[3][4]@0xc, prevMovePathPos[3]@0x418, pausecnt@0xac4). Also converted 2 pre-existing raw pointer-walk loops to direct indexing on already-typed arrays that needed no view struct at all: ProcessSpewItems's `(SpewItem*)((char*)gSpewItems+off)` -> `&gSpewItems[i]` (gSpewItems is already SpewItem[32]) and HealthMeterUpdate's `*(void**)((char*)HealthMeterBG+off+meter*8)` -> `HealthMeterBG[meter][i]` (HealthMeterBG is already void*[3][2]); both loops' now-fully-dead `off` shadow locals and their increments were deleted per claim.law.dead-offset-shadow-removal-safe. Two real matching improvements fell out of these two conversions: ProcessSpewItems real 191->187, HealthMeterUpdate real 277->261 (both STRUCTURAL/parked functions, gated with --update-improved and banked as the new baseline). All 5 baseline-EXACT-or-real-0 functions (AddBoss, BossDeath, BossGenerateEnemy, StartSpewItem, BossActivate) stayed byte-identical (real 0) through every offsetof respelling. BossSpewCoins itself (the flagship/.bss-anchor-gate function, STRUCTURAL/parked per attempt.parked.bossspewcoins.20260829.v1) stayed real 139 (neutral) -- this pass did not touch its register-allocation residual, only resolved its 12 raw-offset sites' names. HealthMeterStart carries no raw-offset sites and was left untouched. Full ninja -j2 green, build/GUNE5D/main.dol: OK, git diff --check clean, single-file diff (src/game/boss/boss.c only).
attributes.law_screen: claim.law.dead-offset-shadow-removal-safe: APPLIED -- ProcessSpewItems's and HealthMeterUpdate's `off` shadow locals became fully dead once their sole use converted to array indexing on an already-typed array; both declarations and increments deleted, directly producing the two real-line improvements. claim.law.declared-alias-vs-repeated-cast: screened, not applied as a technique -- no repeated-cast regression was hit because every multi-field region in this pass used offsetof-only spelling instead of introducing a typed alias in the first place (see multifield-alias-defeats-indexed-addressing below), so the counter-form was never needed. claim.law.large-fn-batch-fuzzy-can-mask-subfield-regression: not applicable -- no function in this TU exceeds ~4000 insns (largest target is BossSpewCoins at 404 insns); fndiff real-line-count was used as the primary per-function gate throughout regardless. claim.law.lwzu-idiom-web-retention: not applicable -- no lwzu-fusable walked-pointer prologue was touched (ProcessSpewItems's it-walk now uses freshly-indexed &gSpewItems[i], never a p+=N accumulator). claim.law.multifield-alias-defeats-indexed-addressing: APPLIED preventively -- BossGenerateEnemy's `e` (index-computed via generate_enemy(...)*916, touching 8 nearby Enemy fields) and the Item-object regions (worldPos triple in ProcessSpewItems, data-union quad in BossSpewCoins/StartSpewItem) were deliberately kept as raw u8*/void* pointers with offsetof-only spelling rather than typed EnemyTailView*/SpewObjView* aliases; zero regressions across all of them, consistent with this law's prediction. claim.law.offsetof-fused-immediate-counter: APPLIED -- every view-struct field access is offsetof(View, field[i]) added to the raw walked/index-computed base pointer, never a typed intermediate, matching this law's fused-immediate form exactly. claim.law.offsetof-overturns-typed-alias-caps: not applicable -- no prior cap on this TU used an undocumented typed-alias/repeated-cast form (this is boss.c's first de-fakematch pass). claim.law.offsetof-rename-array-member-boundary: not applicable -- no raw displacement on an array-typed struct MEMBER accessed via -> was converted (BossGenerateEnemy's pre-existing o->dir/o->pos accesses were untouched by this pass; AddBoss's conversion is offsetof on a void* variable base, not an array member). claim.law.offsetof-rename-isolated-site-outlier: APPLIED as a methodology -- every offsetof-rename site on the already-EXACT functions (BossDeath, AddBoss, BossActivate) was gated individually per function rather than spot-checked, exactly this law's guidance; no isolated regressing site was found. claim.law.offsetof-rename-preserves-protected-web: APPLIED broadly -- every raw-hex-to-offsetof respelling in this pass kept the base pointer's original declared type and single-additive-expression shape; all 5 already-EXACT functions this law's evidence class covers measured neutral (real 0 preserved). claim.law.pointer-walk-array-index-regression: not applicable -- no accumulator-walked (p += STRIDE across iterations) pointer was converted to array-style indexing in this pass; the two array-index conversions were RECOMPUTED-index cases instead (see recomputed-index-array-form-safe). claim.law.recomputed-index-array-form-safe: APPLIED -- both &gSpewItems[i] and HealthMeterBG[meter][i] are loop-counter-recomputed-each-iteration accesses on already-typed arrays, matching this law's safe case; both measured as real improvements, consistent with the law's 'may improve matches' note. claim.law.scalar-read-write-lfsu-mixed-form: not applicable -- no scalar read-immediately-followed-by-write pair had its read form changed independently of its write form (ProcessSpewItems's worldPos read+write pairs were converted symmetrically on both sides). claim.law.walked-base-symbol-identity: not applicable -- no byte offset reachable through two different verified global symbols was touched in this TU.
attributes.metrics_conflict: none -- every touched function's fndiff real either held steady (0 for the 5 already-exact functions, 139 for BossSpewCoins) or improved (191->187, 277->261), with no fuzzy/real or insn-count/real disagreement observed on any of the 8 functions touched.
attributes.sites_left_raw: 4 bare sites remain, all deliberately: the +0x10 (relative to offsetof(SpewObjView,data)) sub-offset literal for the s16 field written as 120 at 4 call sites (BossSpewCoins x3, StartSpewItem x1) inside Item.data, the 0x14-byte anim/oanim/texmod/psys union whose PDB dump (research/xbox_symbols/misc.h Id=3254) is ambiguous/name-colliding across multiple distinct anonymous unions in the same struct and could not be individually verified beyond the union's own base field (already offsetof-named as SpewObjView.data). BossDeath's hdr->+0xd0/+0xd4/+0xd8 (CritterHeader sub-fields) are also left raw but resolve through the named BossCritterView.hdr field first, so the debt scanner does not count them as bare (only the bare numeric literal after a resolved base is flagged); include/game/critter.h's own CritterHeader comment block confirms these three offsets are not among its documented fields.
